title: The logic of NTQR evaluations of noisy AI agents: Complete postulates and logically consistent error correlations
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the theoretical and mathematical framework for unsupervised evaluation of AI algorithms.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on the mathematical and logical consistency of evaluating AI agents (specifically binary classifiers) in an unsupervised setting (i.e., without an answer key).
